Messages.Author: Andrew D. Stewart
Messages.Body:
I have a bunch of Jyhad and Vampire cards that I got several years
ago. I haven't played in ages, but I ran across my cards the other day
and was wondering what cards are rare/uncommon/common. Does anyone know
of a web site that has such a list?

Also, if I can't find anyone in the area that plays Jyhad/Vampire, I
am considering selling my cards, or trading for MTG cards. Where would
be a good place to list them? This group seems like a logical place, but
some groups really have for sale/trade posts and have a designated area
for such things. Thanks.

WotC has lists on their site: http://www.wizards.com/VTES/rules.asp
Spoiler lists are also available on the Rulemonger sites:
http://www.geocities.com/TimesSquare/Realm/9876/ (pick a mirror,
then select "Cards").

> Also, if I can't find anyone in the area that plays Jyhad/Vampire,
I
> am considering selling my cards, or trading for MTG cards. Where would
> be a good place to list them? This group seems like a logical place,
but
> some groups really have for sale/trade posts and have a designated
area
> for such things. Thanks.

rec.games.trading-cards.marketplace.misc is the right place. Just
be sure and put "[VTES]" or "[Jyhad]" in your subject line.

I have a trading area at
http:///vampire.tne.net.au/trades

where you are quite welcome to display what cards you wish to trade. Once you
have placed the cards in the trading lists the rarity of the cards is
displayed next to them. It is currently only set up for displaying trades you
have or want, and not as set up for displaying price for those wishing to sell
them. You can however give general prices or trading conditions in the
comments field when you edit your trades.

I hope that is of some use to you.
